label: Conference organising committee, 2019
basis: Matthew Wilson is named on the organising committee for GeoComputation 2019 in Antoni Moore’s contemporary conference call. The Queenstown event combined the international GeoComputation conference with the New Zealand Geospatial Research Conference in September 2019.
